summary: Russian forces conducted multiple drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, including attacks on Slavyansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv regions, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian air defenses shot down 245 Russian UAVs overnight, while ground battles continued in Sumy, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia directions. A Russian court remanded former Ukrainian diplomat Oleksandr Bankiv in absentia on embezzlement charges related to international aid.
key_points: Russian forces struck Slavyansk with guided aerial bombs, damaging residential buildings and injuring at least one person who remains in critical condition. (Source: @UkraineNow/83119)
Ukrainian Air Force operators destroyed a Russian ZALA Z-20 reconnaissance drone at an altitude of 6,858 meters using STING drones from the 105th separate border unit. (Source: @UkraineNow/83120)
A repeat Russian airstrike on Zaporizhzhia with guided aerial bombs raised the civilian death toll to 22, including a 71-year-old woman killed under rubble. (Source: @UkraineNow/83131)
Russian forces claimed control over Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka in Kharkiv Oblast, with ongoing battles near Shevchenkovo and in Volchansk district forests. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)
Ukrainian forces repelled air attacks across Crimea, Tula, Belgorod, and other regions overnight, destroying 245 Russian UAVs during the previous day. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)
In Belgorod region, a Ukrainian drone strike near a children's playground in Printseva killed a 13-year-old girl and injured two other children aged 7 and 9. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)
Russian forces destroyed a section of the Cherevkovsky bridge in Slavyansk and continued strikes on Odessa port infrastructure and Nikolaev facilities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted widespread drone and missile strikes across Ukraine overnight, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage in multiple regions. Ukrainian air defenses shot down 245 Russian UAVs during the previous day while ground battles continued in eastern and northeastern directions. A Russian court remanded former Ukrainian diplomat Oleksandr Bankiv on embezzlement charges related to international aid.
ukraine: Russian forces struck Slavyansk with guided aerial bombs, damaging residential buildings and infrastructure across different city districts. At least one civilian was injured and remains in critical condition in surgery, according to the Ministry of Emergency Situations. (Source: @UkraineNow/83119)

A repeat Russian airstrike on Zaporizhzhia with guided aerial bombs raised the civilian death toll to 22. Over 90 minutes, eight guided aerial bombs were dropped on the regional center, destroying both residential and non-residential buildings. A 71-year-old woman was found dead under rubble. (Source: @UkraineNow/83131)

Ukrainian Air Force operators using STING drones from the 105th separate border unit set a new record by destroying a Russian ZALA Z-20 reconnaissance drone at an altitude of 6,858 meters. This represents one of the highest-altitude drone interceptions recorded. (Source: @UkraineNow/83120)

Former Ukrainian Deputy Foreign Minister Oleksandr Bankiv was remanded in absentia by a Russian court on charges of embezzling international aid at the start of the full-scale invasion. He faces up to 12 years in prison with property confiscation, along with three alleged accomplices. (Source: @UkraineNow/83137)

Ukrainian tennis player Oksana Oleynikova canceled a charity auction for Ukrainian Armed Forces funding after the WTA barred her participation due to her criticism of Russian players supporting the war. She accused the association of enabling Russian athletes who motivate Russians to kill Ukrainians. (Source: @UkraineNow/83117)
russia: Russian forces claimed control over Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka in Kharkiv Oblast, with ongoing battles near Shevchenkovo and in Volchansk district forests. A storming group of former prisoners from Ukraine's 72nd separate mechanized brigade was destroyed attempting infiltration. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

In Belgorod region, a Ukrainian drone strike near a children's playground in Printseva killed a 13-year-old girl and seriously injured two other children aged 7 and 9. Additional attacks in Koroch and Kazachya Lisitsa injured multiple civilians including children. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

Russian forces destroyed a section of the Cherevkovsky bridge in Slavyansk and continued strikes on Odessa port infrastructure and Nikolaev facilities. Tanks targeted in Odessa region and a cargo ship attacked at sea. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

In Kupyansk, Russian forces control the city center and report constant Ukrainian counterattack attempts from outskirts. Fighting continues for the bridge over the Oskol River in Kupyansk-Uzlovoi. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

North of Konstantinovka, Russian units reportedly entered Alexeevo-Druzhkovka. Near Nikolaypolye, Russian forces are developing success from initial assault groups that broke through to the settlement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)
eastern_front: Russian forces occupied Sukhetske and advanced near Nikanivka and Rodinskoye, according to DeepState map updates. These developments indicate continued pressure in the Donetsk direction. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23715)

The 'Sever' group continues fighting in Kharkiv direction villages including Ivanovka, Bely Kolodez, Baksheevka, and near Shevchenkovo. Forested areas of Volchansk district remain active battle zones. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

Infantry battles continue in Sumy region's Shostkinsky district near Ulanovo and approaches to Volnaya Sloboda. Additional fighting reported in Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Maryino, and Khoten villages south of Ivolzhan. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

In Kupyansk, Russian forces maintain control of the city center with ongoing Ukrainian counterattack attempts from outskirts. Combat continues for the Oskol River bridge in Kupyansk-Uzlovoi. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

North of Konstantinovka, Russian units entered Alexeevo-Druzhkovka. Near Nikolaypolye, Russian forces are consolidating gains from initial assault breakthrough operations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue conducting coordinated drone and missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions, demonstrating persistent aerial capabilities despite Ukrainian air defense improvements. The destruction of 245 Russian UAVs in one day shows effective Ukrainian countermeasures, but the scale of attacks indicates Russia can sustain high-intensity operations. Civilian casualties, particularly children in Belgorod region, highlight the humanitarian impact of cross-border strikes. Ground battles in eastern and northeastern directions suggest Russia is maintaining offensive momentum in key sectors. The remanding of former Ukrainian officials indicates ongoing legal warfare alongside military operations.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defenses have demonstrated improved interception capabilities, shooting down 245 Russian UAVs in a single day and achieving a record-altitude drone kill at 6,858 meters. Ground forces continue defensive operations in Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia directions while reporting successful counterattacks against Russian infiltration attempts. Local authorities are documenting civilian casualties and infrastructure damage for international reporting. The Ukrainian tennis community's response to WTA restrictions reflects broader societal mobilization supporting the war effort. Emergency services continue responding to repeated airstrikes across multiple regions.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian tactical approach appears focused on sustained aerial bombardment combined with ground advances in eastern sectors, particularly around Kharkiv and Donetsk directions. The use of former prisoner storming groups suggests resource constraints in elite unit deployment. Ukrainian STING drone operators achieved a significant technical milestone with the high-altitude ZALA Z-20 interception, indicating advancing domestic drone warfare capabilities. Cross-border civilian casualties in Belgorod region may be intended to pressure Ukrainian operations or demonstrate reach. The legal remanding of Ukrainian officials in absentia represents an information warfare component targeting domestic and international audiences.
